doc.brief: Types of user actions that may be blocked by `GtkApplication`.
doc.md:
Types of user actions that may be blocked by `GtkApplication`.

See [`Application.inhibit()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Application#method:inhibit).

idle.brief: Inhibit the session being marked as idle (and possibly locked)
idle.md:
Inhibit the session being
  marked as idle (and possibly locked)

logout.brief: Inhibit ending the user session by logging out or by shutting down the computer
logout.md:
Inhibit ending the user session
  by logging out or by shutting down the computer

suspend.brief: Inhibit suspending the session or computer
suspend.md:
Inhibit suspending the
  session or computer
